canonical_data: tasks, workflow definitions and runs, steps and actions, screenshots and recordings, credentials, and extracted data in a database the operator runs plus artifact storage
current_repo_note: Every file in the repository is copyleft; the proprietary parts — anti-bot and captcha solving, enterprise gating, billing, and cloud browser vendors — live outside it and plug in by overriding base classes whose open implementations return nothing. A workflow sync mirrors merged changes into a private cloud repository.
strengths: A budgeted, retrying step loop with a failure classifier, and a second-generation tool-calling engine with stall detection
One codebase covers a command line, an embedded library, a self-hosted server with a workflow builder, container orchestration, and a cloud
Broad model backends including local and compatible endpoints, plus a tool server and workflow-automation integrations
weaknesses: The advertised anti-bot and captcha solving are cloud-only overrides of open stubs that return nothing
Telemetry is on by default, and the workflow code block executes user Python in the server process behind an allowlist rather than a sandbox
Package releases trail the repository's tags, and the quick-install path has shipped broken releases
why_it_matters: The most complete self-hostable browser agent with a workflow builder and credential handling, and a clear demonstration of where an open core stops and the vendor cloud begins.
